Backend: 31/31 pytest tests passed (login/logout/session, all 6 seed users, wrong-password 401, unauth 401 on protected endpoints, role permissions still enforced correctly via JWT-derived user - admin view-only, member own-row only, manager own-department only, member cannot set Closed, everyone can view all rows). Sidebar shows correct user name/role at bottom (Aisha Khan admin, Sam Fernandes Member). Admin nav shows Dashboard/Projects/Team/Approvals/Clients/Work Sheet; member sees only Work Sheet. Test data (11 TEST_iter8 work items) cleaned up - 0 leftover.

minor.issue: list_clients() is the only main resource endpoint that does NOT call get_acting_user(request) - it is publicly readable without a session. Likely oversight given every other GET requires auth. Low severity (no writes, and IDs are non-secret) but inconsistent with the request statement 'all GET/POST/PATCH endpoints require a valid session'.
Also unauthenticated (returns enum lists). Probably intentional but worth flagging.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env combined with allow_credentials=True is a browser spec violation - browsers reject Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* with credentials. Works today only because frontend and backend share the same ingress host (same-origin, no CORS preflight). If ever accessed cross-origin the cookie login will silently fail. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host.
